title: Pure Trirealm Rift
summary: A 40-card Trirealm Rift list from Glorious Victors (TCG 3 December 2026) with the four reprints that banish face-down: Small World, Pot of Desires, Gizmek Orochi and Eater of Millions. Every Trirealm Rift monster banishes the top of your Deck face-down when it is summoned, and the archetype's searches and summons all work from those face-down cards, so the list stays at 40 to make each mill likelier to hit the engine.

summary.title: Starters
points: Small World reveals a Trirealm Rift monster and bridges through another: both go face-down, where Blizzards, Gorging Gorge and Hollows can use them.
Trirealm Rift Hollows Special Summons itself on an empty field and adds up to 2 face-down banished Trirealm Rift monsters.
Trirealm Rift Vilvortex banishes 5 to activate and adds a face-down banished Trirealm Rift card every turn.
Trirealm Rift Savage Storms banishes itself and another Trirealm Rift card from the hand face-down and draws 2.

summary.title: Opening: Small World + Darkness + Delectation
steps: Small World reveals Trirealm Rift Darkness, bridges through Gorging Gorge and adds Blizzards; Darkness and Gorging Gorge are banished face-down.
Activate Trirealm Rift Delectation, banishing Small World from the GY and the top 4 cards of the Deck.
Normal Summon Blizzards, which Special Summons Darkness from the banishment.
Delectation banishes Blizzards face-down and Special Summons Gorging Gorge: Darkness over 23 face-down cards, protected by Gorging Gorge.

summary.title: Locks and order
summary.text: Hollows' add, Heavens' add, Blizzards' and Blaze's summons and Verdict's effect each stop you activating anything but Trirealm Rift cards for the rest of the turn, so Small World, Pot of Desires, Emergency Teleport, Terraforming and Gizmek Orochi go first. Gorging Gorge, Havocs, Savage Storms, Vilvortex, Delectation and Darkness don't lock you.

summary.title: Extra Deck
summary.text: Trirealm Rift has no Extra Deck monsters. The generic Links the list is topped up with can be made from any two of its monsters, and Eater of Millions and Gizmek Orochi can banish spare Extra Deck cards face-down, which counts for Trirealm Rift Darkness.

allow.Gizmek Orochi, the Serpentron Sky Slashe: Glorious Victors reprint on the page: banishes the top 8 cards face-down to Special Summon itself.
allow.Eater of Millions: Glorious Victors reprint on the page: banishes cards face-down to summon itself, which works under the Trirealm Rift lock.

smallWorld.note: Havocs, Gorging Gorge and Savage Storms are Level 5 to 7, so they can't be Normal Summoned without a Tribute, and their hand effects need face-down banished cards first (Havocs, Gorging Gorge) or a second Trirealm Rift card in hand (Savage Storms, which only draws).
